# Post-graduation work permit eligibility
> MOCK FIXTURE — not real policy. For development only.

Graduates of eligible college programs must have studied in a field of study linked to a long-term shortage occupation, unless the program is a bachelor's degree or higher [1].
Applications must be submitted within 180 days of receiving final marks [1].
Field-of-study requirements apply to study permit applications submitted on or after 2024-11-01 [2].
